newsitem.title: JAPAN: Matsushita says will form TV venture in Vietnam.
newsitem.headline: Matsushita says will form TV venture in Vietnam.

text.p: Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd said on Thursday that it would set up a joint venture in Vietnam on Friday to produce and sell colour television sets and audio equipment.
Matsushita Electric Vietnam Co Ltd will be 60 percent owned by Matsushita and 40 percent owned by Viettronics Thu Duc Co, a national Vietnamese enterprise, Matsushita said in a statement.
The venture, to be located in Ho Chi Minh City, will be capitalised at $2.83 million, the company said.
It will produce 14-inch, 16-inch, 20-inch, 21-inch, and 25-inch colour television sets and audio equipment, Matsushita said.
The venture is expected to produce 30,000 colour TV sets between November 1996 and March 1997, and 80,000 in the year from April 1, 1997, the company said.
Output of audio equipment is expected to be 5,000 units in the year from April 1, 1997, it said.

Toshiba Corp, one of Matsushita's competitors in the consumer electronics business, said earlier this month that it had set up a joint venture in Vietnam with Viettronics Thu Duc to produce and sell colour television sets.
